newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says privatisations are necessary.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says privatisations are necessary.

text.p: French Finance and Economy Minister Jean Arthuis said in a statement on Tuesday that privatisations were needed in order to finance the recapitalisation of other state companies.

Reacting to statements by Socialist Party spokesman Francois Hollande that his party would stop the privatisation programme, Arthuis said that "(The Socialists) leave it up in the air how they are going to re-float these companies (that need state money). The truth is that they are preparing new taxes for the recapitalisation of these companies."
"The state has the duty to recapitalise these companies and we know that important amounts are needed this year (Credit Lyonnais, GAN, GIAT, Thomson Multimedia) as it has been in the past," he said.
"We have chosen to finance this with the revenues of sales of shares in France Telecom and other companies in order to saveguard the interest of tax payers," Arthuis said.
